name: diffusers-workflow
description: Skills for driving a diffusers-workflow server from Claude Code: a composition skill per model family, one for cutting a series from them, one camera-and-look vocabulary compiled per family, storyboards with a timed animatic, and a playbook for pieces longer than one clip.

plugins.name: dw
plugins.description: Compose MiniMax H3 video, MiniMax Music 3, LTX-2.5, Kandinsky 6.0 and FLUX 3 Klein workflows over a dw MCP server, cut a multi-episode series from them, direct camera and look in each family's caption format, storyboard a scene before it is filmed, and plan a piece longer than one clip from measured levers: which template fits which shape, the hard rules, cost, and how to judge the output.
